interface.signature: doctorStrange(N: int, M: int, graph: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: Number of nodes (N) must be between 1 and 30000.
Number of edges (M) must be between 1 and 30000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: Each edge in the graph must connect nodes between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in range(1, N+1) if is_cut_vertex(node, N, graph))
postconditions.description: The function returns the number of nodes whose removal disconnects the graph.
